introHtml: Water repellent personal protection equipment keeps your team dry and safe in wet conditions. Unlike standard PPE, these items resist moisture, preventing saturation that can weigh workers down or reduce visibility. Perfect for construction, landscaping, or any outdoor job site, they maintain breathability while blocking rain. Customize with your logo for a professional look that performs.
